title: Design Day Bangalore #15 — Visual Communication Design
description:
The theme for January's 2014's Design Day is:

VISUAL COMMUNICATION DESIGN

The agenda includes:
1. Design Story: By an experienced designer to walk us through the trials and tribulations of a career in Design.

2. A Case Study/Skill Building Session: By an experienced Designer to teach us something new.

3. A JAM: You will be given a topic and would have to come up with some design suggestions based on that topic in 2 hours. This is a group activity, where participants are split into groups of 4-5 people. We will have markers, sketchpens and chart papers for your use.

Cheers,

Amit/Kavita/Aashish
